semantics.authorization: host authorization plus nonempty evidence required; failure is human_review
semantics.base_only: ignore matching exception and execute the base branch
semantics.deny_overrides: human_review then no_action dominate; otherwise preserve base
semantics.exception_overrides: unique matching exception replaces base; conflict is human_review
semantics.observation_completion: successful typed observation required; failure is human_review
semantics.observation_type: exact match required; mismatch is human_review
semantics.scope: observed scope must be in allowed_scopes; otherwise false branch
semantics.temporal: observed temporal state must equal policy temporal state; otherwise false branch
